source_text: Superhumerale et rationale iudicii — onera populi in umeris, nomina in corde. Pontifex memor ecclesiae.
pass_a_gloss: Ephod and breastpiece of-judgment — burdens of-people on shoulders, names on heart. High-priest mindful of-church.
pass_b_english: Ephod and [[breastpiece of judgment >> Bible:Exodus 28:15-29]]: the people’s burdens on the shoulders, their names on the heart. The high priest keeps the church in mind.
